categories.description: Display-only topical labels, e.g. ai and bots. The source label (first-party, partner, or community) goes in the index entry, not here.

layout.description: router generates one function that dispatches on URL path; separate deploys each operation as its own function.

runtime.description: The runtime of the function the template scaffolds; nodejs24 when left out. A python314 template is a uv project: neon functions new copies its files as they are, locks it with uv lock, and declares the function with runtime: "python314" and the template's entrypoint.

entrypoint.description: python314 only, and required there. The ASGI app as module:attr, such as main:app.

files.description: python314 only, and required there. The project's files, relative to functions/, copied into the function's directory as they are. Must include pyproject.toml; leave uv.lock out, since neon functions new creates it.

required.description: Written as the variable's required in neon.ts. true (the default) fails neon deploy and neon dev while it is unset; false lets both run without it; "default-branch" requires it only when deploying the project's default branch.

source.description: Module path relative to this template.json.

route.description: Router layout: the URL path. Defaults to /<id>.

slug.description: Separate layout: the Neon function slug.

triggers.description: Function Triggers that neon functions new declares in neon.ts, keyed by name. A trigger is written only when the operation it names is scaffolded. Names must be unique within the template, and operation must name one of this template's operations.

cron.description: A numeric five-field cron expression in UTC, fields separated by single spaces, each field starting with a digit or *.

bucket.description: The Object Storage bucket to watch, 3-63 characters. neon functions new does not declare it; it asks the user to run neon config add bucket when neon.ts lacks it.

prefix.description: An exact object-key prefix, such as images/, of at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes with no control characters. Omit it to match every key in the bucket.

features.description: Neon products the template uses, shown as "Built with" on its neon.com page in this order, so list the most important first. Leave out Functions: every template is one. Write each feature as its id; function-triggers can instead be an object that lists the trigger types the template sets up. List each feature once.

types.description: Trigger types the template sets up. Values match the Neon API's trigger `type`.

featureId.description: postgres: Lakebase Postgres. lakebase-search: Lakebase Search. auth: Managed Better Auth. data-api: Data API. realtime: Realtime. object-storage: Object Storage. ai-gateway: AI Gateway. function-triggers: Function Triggers.

triggerType.description: schedule: a cron schedule. storage_object_created: an object upload to an Object Storage bucket.

triggerName.description: Up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. It becomes the trigger's key in neon.ts.

triggerOperation.description: The id of the operation whose function the trigger calls. Required when the template has operations, and not allowed when it has none.

triggerPath.description: The URL path the trigger posts to, at most 2048 characters, written as functionPath (left out when it is /). Not allowed on a router operation's trigger, which posts to the operation's route.
